examples.label: FAQ list with question headings and answers
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-h5" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold">Can I move an existing site onto Mishka? <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" class="mt-2 text-zinc-600">Yes. Import your pages as HTML and the builder maps most markup onto blocks automatically; anything it cannot match stays as a raw block you can edit by hand.
<.component component_name="chelekom-h5" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold">Do my editors need to understand HEEx? <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" class="mt-2 text-zinc-600">No. Editors only ever see the block palette and the inspector. HEEx is what the builder writes for you underneath.
<.component component_name="chelekom-h5" site="Global" font_weight="font-semibold">What happens when my trial ends? <.component component_name="chelekom-p" site="Global" size="small" class="mt-2 text-zinc-600">Your sites stay online and read-only for another fourteen days. Nothing is deleted until you ask us to delete it.
